notes.title: Halloween Update 🎃
notes.content:
🍬 Trick or treat! 👻

Here's the Halloween Update of Tidy Cauldron! This free update comes with 15 new levels with a new background and music, 4 new animated ingredients, and 4 new achievements. All Halloween-themed 🧛 You can play these levels at any time, they are independent from the 100 levels of the base game.

This update comes with some Quality-of-Life upgrades.

[previewyoutube=eoolem7Tne4;full][/previewyoutube]

🛠️ QoL and improvements 🛠️

 You can now either hold the left mouse button or click to pick up an ingredient.
 You can quickly remove an ingredient from the grid by right-clicking on it.
 Icons added on bookmarks on the level selection screen, corresponding to each chapter.
 Fixes on UI (background images, positions on screen, and transitions).
 Fix missing sound when putting an ingredient back down.
 Fixes on the Japanese localization.
 Ingredients now fit on the SteamDeck screen on all levels.

Steam Cloud save is coming shortly. We're now working on properly making Tidy Cauldron compatible with SteamDeck and looking into making a Mac version. Widescreen resolutions will come soon.

As Halloween is our favorite period of the year, this free update comes with a 20% discount on the game during all Steam Scream Fest. We also added temporary Halloween decorations in the game to celebrate this spooky event.

Don't hesitate to report any bugs or suggestions you may have in the Steam discussions if you encounter any issues!

Please consider leaving a review if you enjoy our game! It helps us greatly with visibility 🫰

Have a spooky good time tidying!
Flo and Cléo from Purring Campfire 🏕️

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese localization and first patch! 💫
notes.content:
Olá! 🌞

We're glad to announce that Tidy Cauldron is now fully translated into Brazilian Portuguese thanks to the amazing Thiago Mania!

This update comes with our first patch fixing minor bugs. 🛠️

Don't hesitate to report any bug or suggestion you may have on the Steam discussions if you encounter any issues!

Please consider leaving a review if you enjoy our game, it helps small teams like us greatly with visibility. 🫰

Patch notes

 Achievements related to the skip feature can now be unlocked after the game is complete by skipping any levels.
 Bugfix achievements "A witch is born", "Broomance", and "Clean Freak" now unlock properly. For players who should have unlocked them and encountered issues, it will be fixed the next time you launch the game: all the missing achievements will be unlocked automatically on the home screen.
 Bugfix achievement "66...6?" now unlocks properly when level 66 is complete.
 Bugfix buttons disappearing on the Credits screen.

Happy tidying!
Flo and Cléo from Purring Campfire 🏕️

notes.title: Tidy Cauldron is OUT NOW
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863646/715e8af9c15a13860f6196910fc71166f2bdef52.png

Today's the day! Our witchy puzzle game about tidying is finally out. 🧹

You can now get the full version and tidy 100 levels across 3 unique backgrounds to help 3 messy witches tidy up their chaos! 26 animated magical ingredients are waiting to be discovered and organized across increasingly bigger grids.

Watch the launch trailer here:
[previewyoutube=MvZ0rDX54gs;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you will like our game, and are looking forward to reading your feedback. Please consider leaving a Steam review, it helps us so much with visibility, and we can see what you liked and what we can improve. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions feel free to contact us.

As a way to thank you for your support, we are releasing Tidy Cauldron with a  7-day long 15% launch discount.

We are excited to hear from you, have fun tidying!
Flo and Cléo from Purring Campfire 🏕️

notes.title: Only 3 days left before the launch of Tidy Cauldron!
notes.content:
That's been such an intense road.

Many things happened to us this year; we got featured in the Wholesome Direct which gave us a lot of exposure. Many people got to discover our demo during the Steam Next Fest. Many streamers and YouTubers featured our games, some of whom we contacted, and some spontaneously. We are very grateful for all of this.

This is how it started with the 48h gamejam on ithch.io in 2020, versus how it looks now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863646/2b2c04424c21e3e45411a0f96f69325242bdb862.gif

We are so proud to see how far we have come since the beginning of this project.  This is our first commercial game, our first time putting something out there besides a game jam game or a student project. We are learning many things and are very excited about what's next. 
We'd like to thank everyone for your support 🫶

If you haven't already, wishlist the game to get notified as soon as Tidy Cauldron is released. 

See you on Wednesday! ✨
Flo and Cléo from Purring Campfire

notes.title: Cozy puzzle game Tidy Cauldron is coming to Steam on July 31st!
notes.content:
Our first indie game finally has a release date!

We're thrilled to announce that our upcoming puzzle game Tidy Cauldron is coming very soon. Join us on July 31st to organize magical ingredients to craft potions and cast spells!

Watch the new release date reveal trailer now:
[previewyoutube=qq4dm1wN00M;full][/previewyoutube]

What to expect
 Magical Puzzles: Solve 100 handcrafted levels that progressively challenge and engage your organizational skills and wit.
 Mystical Ingredients: From a Cerberus eagerly awaiting to be pat to a multiple-eyed cross-shaped Demon, encounter 26 unique animated ingredients.
 Accessible Gameplay: Intuitively organize ingredients using only your mouse, perfect for beginners and seasoned players alike.
 Enchanting Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in visually captivating pixel art across 3 unique backgrounds, exploring the esoteric arts of potion crafting, summoning, and tarot reading.
 5 languages: Tidy Cauldron is fully translated into English, French, Spanish, Italian, and Korean. More languages to come in the future!

In the meantime, you can play the free demo featuring 15 exclusive puzzles to get a taste of the game.
If you haven't already, wishlist the game to get notified as soon as Tidy Cauldron is available on Wednesday, July 31st!

Stay magical ✨
Flo and Cléo from Purring Campfire
